BudgetScope: Capacities of currently retained exact-cell, pending-cell and large-proxy index arrays. This is not a total renderer, WASM heap or GPU memory limit; source/projected geometry, labels, dictionary entries, object headers and reallocation/GC transients are separate.

PressureRegression.Fixture: Real clipped terrain primitives in a 2048 × 2048 synthetic frame: a folded left patch creates excessive exact memberships after a right-hand pixel is cached; a later-source small patch tests terrain ties, and a model tests rims first demanded after fallback. A separate fixture places 65,537 degenerate groups with 8 × 8 cell bounds before a valid late group. Reused 512 × 384 → 4096 × 2160 → 384 × 640 frames exercise capacity accounting and grid coarsening.
Assertions: Exact and coarse exhaustion use the full 16 MiB budget without exceeding it.
Cached and cache-cleared pre-transition pixels retain exact answers.
Independent eager terrain/occlusion answers match, including source-order ties and rims.
A retained pressure frame survives another frame.
Coarse fallback includes the valid group appended after indexing stopped.
Actual buffer capacity equals the accounted value across pool reuse and grid replacement; cell array length stays at or below 16,384.

HorizonDiagnostic.Scope: Nine bundled Manhattan tiles with flat visual terrain and a constant-ground reference pose, whereas the live failure had relief enabled. Logical map 1800 × 807, alternate logical 1800 × 924, enlarged logical stress 3600 × 1848, and Normal pixel size 1. Pixel size 2 is a diagnostic choice; the live artwork resolution was not captured. The observed compositor DPR 2 alone does not enlarge depth dimensions. The live vector cache can contain more than these nine tiles.
Limitations: This deterministic nine-tile native subset did not reproduce the browser OOM.
The browser failure had visual relief and a potentially larger live tile cache; this probe uses flat visual terrain and a constant-ground reference pose.
Compositor DPR2 was observed, but the actual failing artwork pixel size was not captured. Pixel size2 is a diagnostic choice.
